Container.Name: akou
Container.Overview: Self-hosted transcription server. A program uploads an audio file and reads back the text with word and segment times and speaker labels, as JSON, SRT or VTT, by long-poll, an event feed or a signed webhook. It also answers the OpenAI transcription endpoint (POST /v1/audio/transcriptions). A web page shows the job queue, the API keys, the models and the settings. This is the server mode of akou, a call recorder for macOS, with the same core. [br][br] [b]First use:[/b] the speech models (about 3 GB) download on the first job. Set the web page's admin password from the Unraid terminal, at least 12 characters: printf '%s' 'your-password' | docker exec -i akou akou admin set-password then log in and create one API key per program on the Keys page. [br][br] [b]Network:[/b] akou has no TLS of its own and listens on the network only with AKOU_BEHIND_PROXY set to true. Keep it on your LAN, or put a reverse proxy with TLS in front before you reach it from outside. [br][br] The image tag is the akou version; there is no latest tag. For a GPU use the -cuda or -vulkan tag (see the docs). More info: https://geiserx.github.io/akou/server/
